findings: SNL37 directly identifies two M1587 right and two M1588 left support brackets per vehicle. HB134 describes support from inside and outside track-extension plating.

The selected candidate uses one bracket from each side of each casing to the adjacent M1978 inner or M1976 outer wing plate. Z-section, stock, station and hole positions are inferred; no dimensioned bracket drawing has been located.

Seven5/16x7/8inch case rivets per bracket follow the direct SNL167:010 joint allocations. Together with eight M1581 register rivets this selects22long body rivets, conflicting with the nested16. The joint-level count is selected for physically distinct attachments; no extra coincident parts are created.

Hull mounting uses two half-inch by one-and-a-half-inch bolt/nut/lockwasher sets per bracket as an explicit reconstruction assumption. SNL31:007 documents that bolt type for other equipment; it does NOT identify its use or quantity at M1587/M1588. Survey identity denotes the selected standard fastener type only. These eight mounting sets must not be reported as source-confirmed casing quantities.
The existing nuts and washers follow inspected SNL128/270 standard type identities. Threads and bracket bending/fastener loads are unqualified.
